Thanks for taking this on. Attaching our initial MSA (Nebula_MSA_Draft_v1.docx) and a rough order form with anticipated usage tiers. Can we aim for a 3-business-day turnaround on initial redlines? If you need anything else to prioritize (e.g., sample exhibit for IP/data flows), say so.

I attached our internal intake checklist and a short kickoff playbook (redwood_intake_checklist.pdf) — will push the checklist to the shared drive once initial comments are in.

Elena — looping back with a few clarifying items after a quick scan: 
- Indemnity: your draft expands reverse indemnities in a few spots. Could you confirm whether you expect reciprocal IP indemnity or a limited carve-out for third-party claims? If you have precedent language, paste it and we can align.
- Exhibit mapping: we'll need a short Exhibit A that maps Redwood deliverables to Nebula billing tiers. I can draft a starter and send it in-line with the redlines.
- Order form: the usage tiers look fine, but we need expected monthly active tokens for each tier to size burst capacity. Can procurement provide historical/expected numbers?

Proposed timeline:
- Wed 23 Jul: Jonas sends first-pass redlines on the MSA (commercial + core clauses)
- Thu 24 Jul: Marissa returns annotated order form with exhibit mapping
- Mon 28 Jul: joint sync if needed to resolve material clauses

Also, procurement PO process — do you require a specific contract signature routing or e-sign (DocuSign) + PO prior to provisioning? If so we can route accordingly.

Attachments referenced: redwood_intake_checklist.pdf (internal).

—Marissa
